description: Build-unit dependency graph for ssp-platform-monorepo. Consumed by the sugarsnappeas/selector orb's analyse.py, which diffs a revision range, marks directly-changed nodes, walks dependents transitively, and emits one pipeline lane per selected node.

selection.direct_match: A changed file selects a node when its repo-relative path matches any glob in that node's `paths`. Globs follow fnmatch/pathlib semantics: `*` does not cross `/`, `**` does.
selection.propagation: reverse-transitive-closure over `depends_on` — if node X is selected and node Y lists X in Y.depends_on, Y is selected too, recursively.
selection.full_run_paths: A changed file matching any glob in the top-level `full_run_paths` selects EVERY node, bypassing per-node matching. These are repo-wide files the graph itself depends on.
selection.unmatched_paths: A changed file that matches no node and no full_run_paths glob selects nothing. Selectors should record it in the traversal log as unattributed.
selection.ordering: `depends_on` is a strict partial order; the graph is acyclic. Lanes may be run in any order or in parallel — the DAG describes impact, not build sequencing.
